concept.reason: Actual full holotype mount photo and museum comparative anatomy establish original gate.

scope: Whole lightly built iguanodontian with proportionately shorter forelimbs than Iguanodon. Not a scaled or recoloured stout Iguanodon.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic living reconstruction based on holotype NHMUK PV R5764. Museum mount contains80–90% real bones; displayed skull is a cast assembled from preserved separate skull bones and some missing parts are replicated. Seven metres is a species-level approximate display length, not direct measurement of this specimen. Pose, skin and colour inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 依据正模NHMUK PV R5764的完整活体美术复原。装架含80–90%真骨，展示头骨是依据分离原骨组合的翻模，部分缺失骨骼补配。7米为物种近似展示尺度，不是该个体实测；姿态、皮肤与颜色属推断。

scale.basis: Approximate species length stated by UK Environment Agency2023; not measurement of R5764 or identification proof for reported footprints.

diagnostic_targets: Lighter narrower trunk/shoulder build than Iguanodon bernissartensis at normalized scale.
Forelimbs conspicuously shorter relative to hindlimbs than Iguanodon; do not stretch arms into stocky quadruped pose.
Low elongate beaked skull, modest thumb spikes and grasping/laterally separate outer digits.
Long balancing tail, near-horizontal trunk in chosen bipedal stance; no tail-supported kangaroo posture.
Whole animal without horn, sail or hadrosaur crest.
specimen_basis: Official NHM photograph of holotype in Hintze Hall actually viewed; NHM catalogue search identifies PV R5764, approx165bones. Museum account directly distinguishes lighter build and shorter forelimbs from Iguanodon.
acceptance_checks: Normalized side silhouette visibly lighter and relatively shorter-armed than Iguanodon, not only reduced scale.
Both arms/hindlimbs and complete tail remain present; thumb spikes modest and separate.
Keep balanced bipedal reconstruction, no claim habitual gait proven by this mount.
Four standard views only, independent original morphology review.
